oracle.quality: Blind assessment through upstream promptfoo llm-rubric, followed by independent primary-source verification
oracle.rubric: Pass only if the report answers every requested task part, provides at least five distinct source URLs, attributes each version/interface/lifecycle claim to a supporting primary source, separates executed evidence from source review, and states unresolved facts without inventing outcomes. Any unsupported factual claim or missing task part fails. Compare anonymous outputs without arm identity; independently reread every decisive citation before counting a pass.

oracle.fault_controls: Same evaluation must fail an empty report, unsupported citation and missing native completion
oracle.win_rule: Only an independently verified improvement with no loss of completion, primary-source support or lifecycle qualifies overlap adoption; equal quality favors fewer moving parts
